Between 2000 and 2025, Circuit Park Zandvoort hosted five races (2021–2025), and the winners were:

- 2021: Max Verstappen
- 2022: Max Verstappen
- 2023: Max Verstappen
- 2024: Lando Norris
- 2025: Oscar Piastri

Max Verstappen won three of these, more than any other driver.

ANSWER: Max Verstappen
